triage.source: PLACEHOLDER rules copied from contracts/examples/manifest.malaria_thin.json; Track E replaces them with sourced thresholds. 1000 cells matches NLM Malaria Screener's capture target (CameraActivity.totalCellNeeded), which is not a clinical threshold.

provenance.source: NLM Malaria Screener's Sudan-retrained thin-smear CNN, malaria_thinsmear_44_retrainSudan_20P_4000C_separate.pb: the model the NLM app loads (CameraActivity.java line 277, https://github.com/LHNCBC/MalariaScreener commit c485a21). Converted from TensorFlow to ONNX with tf2onnx 1.17.0; parity with the original graph is UNVERIFIED (see README).
provenance.licence: UNVERIFIED: the root LICENSE is BSD-style with NLM attribution, but 85+ source files carry GPLv3 headers and the weights have no licence or provenance file (docs/spikes/S1-malaria-screener.md). Weights stay out of git until resolved.
training_data: UNVERIFIED: not documented by NLM; the file name suggests retraining on 20 patients / 4000 cells, possibly from Sudan
provenance.notes: Chosen for the demo because NLM pairs it with this segmentation; replace it after measurement on annotated field images. quality is PROVISIONAL, from 8 RBCNet fields (5312x2988): QualityGate blur 12.8-15.8 and 33-37% exactly-black pixels from the eyepiece vignette; uncertainty values are PLACEHOLDERS from the contract example. Output column 0 is P(parasitized) (TensorFlowClassifier.recongnize_batch), so labels are [parasitized, uninfected].
